identity.title: Maria Rodriguez as Senior Sales Representative
identity.description: Maria's achievement orientation and collaborative nature combined with the demands of a high-performance sales role requiring efficiency, mobility, and cross-functional coordination.

synthesis.quote: Every minute I spend fighting with our systems is a minute I'm not spending with customers. I've figured out workarounds, but I shouldn't have to.

goalsAsExperienced.text: Hit aggressive sales targets while maintaining genuine customer relationships
Minimise administrative overhead to maximise selling time
Build reputation that supports advancement to management
Stay informed on products and competitive landscape without lengthy training

painPoints.text: Achievement drive frustrated by inefficient internal systems
painPoints.emergesFrom: Maria's impatience with inefficiency collides with role's administrative requirements

painPoints.text: Mobile limitations impact her ability to perform while travelling
painPoints.emergesFrom: Maria's autonomy needs meet role's heavy travel requirements

painPoints.text: Change resistance conflicts with system updates that disrupt her workflow
painPoints.emergesFrom: Maria's protection of successful workflows meets role's evolving tool landscape

painPoints.text: Information gaps undermine her customer relationships
painPoints.emergesFrom: Maria's relationship focus meets role's poor internal communication

barriers.barrier: Complex systems that require multiple logins
barriers.impact: Wastes time and creates frustration during customer interactions
barriers.workarounds: Uses password manager and bookmarks to streamline access
barriers.emergesFrom: Maria's efficiency drive meets fragmented technology stack

barriers.barrier: Limited mobile functionality for key applications
barriers.impact: Reduces productivity while traveling to customer sites
barriers.workarounds: Relies on phone calls and email when traveling

barriers.barrier: Inadequate integration between sales and marketing tools
barriers.impact: Manual data entry and coordination overhead
barriers.workarounds: Manually coordinates between systems and teams

barriers.barrier: Insufficient training time for new features
barriers.impact: Slower adoption and potential errors in customer conversations
barriers.workarounds: Learns on-the-job and relies on peer support
barriers.emergesFrom: Maria's hands-on learning preference helps but formal support is lacking

barriers.barrier: Unclear company strategic direction affects sales messaging
barriers.impact: Inconsistent customer messaging and lost opportunities
barriers.workarounds: Develops own customer-focused messaging based on feedback

barriers.barrier: Poor communication about product updates and competitive positioning
barriers.impact: Surprised by customer questions or competitor moves
barriers.workarounds: Maintains informal network with product management team
barriers.emergesFrom: Maria's network-building strength compensates for organisational gaps

barriers.barrier: Unclear approval authority for custom pricing and deal structures
barriers.impact: Delays deals and creates customer frustration
barriers.workarounds: Maintains relationships with multiple decision makers for faster approvals

opportunities: Mobile-first tools that work seamlessly on the road
Integrated systems that reduce context-switching and duplicate entry
Quick-reference product updates optimised for sales conversations
Streamlined approval workflows with clear authority and fast turnaround
Peer learning platforms that match her hands-on learning style
Recognition systems that highlight high performers to leadership
synthesis.emotionalContext: Generally positive and energetic, but frequently frustrated by internal friction. Feels pride in customer successes and team contributions. Anxiety during performance reviews despite strong track record.
